raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The graph is a line plot showing the performance of three different models—Teacher, Self-Training, and PST—measured by accuracy (y-axis) across varying leak rates (x-axis). The x-axis, labeled "漏标率" (leak rate), ranges from 0 to 0.585 with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.1, and is presented on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Acc" (accuracy), ranges from 52.5 to 72.5, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5, also on a linear scale. The red line with circular markers represents the Teacher model, starting at an accuracy of approximately 71.5 at a leak rate of 0 and decreasing to about 52.5 at a leak rate of 0.585. The blue line with square markers represents the Self-Training model, beginning at approximately 70.0 and decreasing to 52.5 at the highest leak rate. The green line with circular markers represents the PST model, starting at around 71.8 and decreasing to approximately 61.5 at a leak rate of 0.585. All three lines show a general downward trend as the leak rate increases, with the Teacher and Self-Training models converging at the lowest leak rate, and the PST model maintaining higher accuracy across all leak rates.
